# Adolf Petushkov Engineering Ecosystem — Comprehensive LLM Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Central architectural index, open-source matrix, and technology registry of Lead Software Architect Adolf Petushkov (marko1olo). Covers 10+ production web applications, game engines, clinical AI pipelines, DSP audio systems, and high-load communication infrastructures.

## Executive Summary
- Primary Architect: Adolf Petushkov (marko1olo)
- Ecosystem Focus: High-throughput async architectures, zero-GC hot paths, clinical AI reliability, computational physics, and zero-dependency Vanilla Web interfaces.
- Portfolio Showcase: https://marko1olo.github.io/marko1olo/
- GitHub Profile: https://github.com/marko1olo

## Architectural Matrix & Production Projects
1. **DENTE Dental CRM** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/dental-crm/`)
   - Domain: Medical & Clinical Practice Management
   - Stack: Fastify 5.2, PostgreSQL 18, React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Vanilla CSS
   - Core Modules: Interactive FDI Odontogram, 3D DICOM Volume Renderer, ICD-10 Diagnosis Engine, Financial Audit Ledger.
2. **StomChat** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/stomchat/`)
   - Domain: Omnichannel Clinical Messaging & Telephony
   - Stack: Telethon, Python 3.11, FastAPI, WebSockets, WhatsApp Business Cloud API
   - Core Modules: 3-column operator console, 60 FPS real-time SLA telemetry, zero-loss message queuing.
3. **AgentRouter Setup Guide** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/agentrouter-setup-guide/`)
   - Domain: AI Infrastructure, LLM Gateways & WAF Homoglyph Security
   - Stack: TypeScript, TLS 1.3, Local HTTP Proxy, Claude/Cline/Cursor Interceptor
   - Core Modules: Dynamic homoglyph cipher, model fallback matrix, latency ping benchmarker.
4. **Token Audit** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/token-audit/`)
   - Domain: LLM Cost Telemetry & BPE Tokenizer Analytics
   - Stack: JavaScript ES6+, Web Workers, High-Precision Math, Cyberpunk Terminal UI
   - Core Modules: Multi-model cost waterfall calculator (Claude Opus, GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3), batch estimation engine.
5. **Nexus Media Engine** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/nexus-media-engine/`)
   - Domain: Digital Signal Processing (DSP) & Web Audio Synthesis
   - Stack: Web Audio API (OscillatorNode, GainNode, AnalyserNode), HTML5 Canvas
   - Core Modules: Real-time multi-waveform synth (Sawtooth/Sine/Square/Triangle), 60 FPS FFT frequency spectrum analyzer.
6. **Avito Dental AI Bot** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/avito-dental-ai-bot/`)
   - Domain: Clinical Lead Generation & Anti-Hallucination Safety
   - Stack: Python, FastAPI, Async Queue, Pydantic Schema Validator
   - Core Modules: 4-Stage Veto Pipeline (Intent -> Clinical Guardrails -> Cost Estimation -> CRM Sync).
7. **Hecton-8** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/Hecton8/`)
   - Domain: NASA-Punk / Deep Sea Noir 3D Unity Game Engine
   - Stack: Unity 6000, C#, Burst Compiler, Unity Mathematics, Job System
   - Core Modules: Hydro-X Sonar propagation, Bathymetric depth selector (8,420m @ 86.8 MPa), zero-GC physics.
8. **Gigahrush** (`https://marko1olo.github.io/gigahrush/`)
   - Domain: 2.5D Retro Game Engine & Atmospheric Physics
   - Stack: C++23 / WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, Vanilla JS
   - Core Modules: 2.5D DDA Raycaster, cellular gas diffusion engine, interactive terminal.
9. **TGACH & dvachbot** (`https://tgach.top` & `https://marko1olo.github.io/dvachbot/`)
   - Domain: Hybrid Imageboard & Telegram Broadcaster
   - Stack: FastAPI, Jinja2 SSR, WebSockets, Python Telethon, @dvach_Chatbot
   - Core Modules: Bidirectional Telegram sync, Floyd-Steinberg/Atkinson dithering, WebM-to-WebP transcoder.

## Universal UI/UX Capabilities
- Universal Command Palette (`Ctrl + K` / `Cmd + K`): Instant fuzzy search across all projects.
- Web Audio Synthesizer Feedback: Interactive tone generation for clicks and hover events.
- Zero-CLS Responsive Layouts: Fluid design systems adhering strictly to 375px mobile through 4K displays.
